background: Secure Trust Bank is a UK specialist lender listed in London, funded by retail savings and lending on vehicle finance, retail point-of-sale finance, real-estate development and commercial finance.
synthesis: None of the three main agencies rates the bank, so the figures carry the whole case. Against UK small banks capital is on the weak side, CET1 of 14.3% in the bottom quarter and leverage of 10.3% below the peer median, and LCR of 209% is also below the median. Since 31 Dec 2023 CET1 has risen 1.6 points and leverage 0.6 points, with LCR broadly flat, in figures to 30 Jun 2026.
